svg.title: The tiled conducting floor and the structures' steel
svg.desc: Left, in plan: the floor around a profile, fine tiles within 30 m along the line and 10 m beyond the profile's width across, coarse tiles beyond, to 200 m every way. Right, in elevation: the tiles lie on the terrain and carry induced charges; a structure's steel members cut into pieces of at most 3 m, each with its own charge; all held at zero potential and solved together.
svg.text: The tiled floor: the terrain as a conductor at zero potential
fine tiles (2 m): ±30 m along, profile width + 10 m across
coarse tiles (8 m) beyond, to 200 m every way (not to scale)
held at 0 V on its surface
each tile: a uniform charge σ, 0 V at its centre
solved together: A·x = −φline (LU on all cores)
memory 16 bytes × n²; a floor over 2 GB is refused
